notes.text: Use only the Steam Corrupted Compendium (3705392682, pack MiaoYingCorrupted_Compendium_workshop.pack) and delete the LoversLab MiaoYingCorrupted_Compendium.pack from the data folder. The 'workshop fix' upload (3754256443) is obsolete.
